memoryBuilder.verseText: Be glad in the Lord always. I will say it again — be glad!

sequence.prompt: What happened in Philippi? Put it in order.

items.label: Paul set a trapped woman free
They were thrown into the dark prison
At midnight they sang to God

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: Everything was not fine — God was still there
They lay in the dark and listened
It made the jailer ask about Jesus

application.question: They sang when things went wrong. What could you do next time something goes wrong?
application.followUp: Singing in the dark is not pretending to be happy. Everything really had gone wrong, and God really was with them, and both were true at once. The prisoners could not help listening. Sing in the dark.
